item.title: Deckosaurus 0.3.8
item.description:
Deckosaurus 0.3.8

  • Transcripts keep their layout on Macs with always-visible scroll bars. With a mouse (no trackpad), or "Show scroll bars: Always", the transcript's scroll bar used to appear and disappear as a reply streamed in, and each time it did, tables and the turn's timestamp were laid out for a width the pane no longer had. The scroll bar's space is now kept, so the text no longer shifts. Trackpad Macs look exactly as before.

item.title: Deckosaurus 0.3.5
item.description:
Deckosaurus 0.3.5

Anonymous usage statistics, on by default, off in one click. Deckosaurus now sends three small signals — that it launched (version, channel, macOS version, processor), that an update check ran, and that an update installed — with a random install id and nothing else. No names, paths or content, ever, and the address a request comes from is never kept. The first launch shows a one-line notice before anything is sent.

  • Preferences ▸ Updates has the "Share anonymous usage statistics" switch and a link to the privacy policy; turning it off deletes the install id.
  • About links the privacy policy beside the release notes.
  • The policy itself: https://updates.deckosaurus.com/privacy.html — questions to privacy@deckosaurus.com.

item.title: Deckosaurus 0.3.3
item.description:
Deckosaurus 0.3.3

  • Moving a workspace to another board window no longer crashes the app.

item.title: Deckosaurus 0.3.2
item.description:
Deckosaurus 0.3.2

Fixes the launch crash in 0.3.0. Installed on any Mac other than the one that built it, 0.3.0 died a few seconds after launch while loading its bundled resources. 0.3.2 loads them from where they actually live in the app bundle, and the release checks now fail any build that could repeat this.

  • Brand glyphs and the terminal's shell integration resolve from the app bundle on every Mac.
  • The terminal library (GhosttyTerminalKit 0.1.8) carries the same fix.

Everything from 0.3.0 is unchanged: OpenRouter as the second coding agent, the model browser, and the About box's channel and release-notes links.

item.title: Deckosaurus 0.3.0
item.description:
Deckosaurus 0.3.0

A second coding agent: OpenRouter

  • OpenRouter joins Claude Code. One API key, almost any model — enter it in Preferences ▸ Coding Agents ▸ OpenRouter and press Check connection.
  • Browse all models in their own window: search, filter by free/tools/vision/reasoning/context length, sort, star the ones you use, and read each model's limits before you pick it.
  • Choose the agent per workspace — in New Workspace, or later in the workspace's settings — and, for OpenRouter, the model too. The chat header shows what is running and lets you switch.
  • Your OpenRouter key is stored only in your login Keychain. The app never logs it and never sends it anywhere but OpenRouter.

Also in this release

  • Development builds are badged with their instance so they can never be mistaken for the installed app, and each keeps its own data.
  • About has a copy button for the version line — handy for bug reports.
  • New Workspace's Options group is a plain section; the Search sidebar says how many files matched; release notes render emphasis correctly.

item.title: Deckosaurus 0.2.12
item.description:
Deckosaurus 0.2.12

About knows your channel

  • About now shows which release channel you are subscribed to and what the update feed says about the build you are running — for example "0.2.12 (13) is on canary since 23 Sep" — with a link to these release notes.
  • Preferences ▸ Updates carries the same line under "Last checked", so "You're up to date" is never ambiguous again.
  • A build that is not in the feed, an unreachable feed, or a local development build each say so plainly.

Smaller things

  • Every release now ships with notes; the update dialog will no longer be blank.
